title: Cosmic Inflation From Regular Black Holes
summary: We study braneworld cosmology in quasi-topological gravity (QTG) with an infinite tower of higher-curvature terms, focusing on the case in which the bulk admits regular black hole solutions. We derive the $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric junction conditions for a FLRW brane moving in a static, spherically symmetric bulk geometry, and obtain the corresponding modified Friedmann equations for the scale factor.
